Speed of light

The speed of light in vacuum, commonly denoted c, is a universal physical constant. It is exactly 299,792,458 metres per second.

The value has been exact since 1983, when the metre was redefined in terms of the speed of light.

Light travels about 300,000 kilometres in one second.
